description: A black USB hub with several ports sits on the bed in front of you, with a white cable already plugged in and a loose black USB cable lying across the sheet. The left hand slides in from the left to steady the hub while the right hand reaches in from the right, grips the black USB plug as a right-hand object, pulls it upward out of the hub, then lowers and pushes the plug back toward the hub to reinsert it before both hands ease away.
